title: Employer Administration Guide for Employer Group Contracts: Eligibility Standards and Enrollment Windows
content:
Under Employer Group Contracts, which employees and family members may be covered, and the windows within which enrollments and additions are made, are set per Cascade Group Dental & Vision segment as follows.

## Standards that differ by segment

| Segment | Minimum regular hours per week for eligibility | Domestic partners may be enrolled as dependents | Group may keep retirees enrolled | Late-entrant rules apply |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 | 30 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 | 30 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | 30 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 | 20 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | 20 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus | 20 | Yes | Yes | No |

## Windows and options common to every segment

| Item | Value in all six segments |
|---|---|
| New-hire eligibility waiting periods the employer may choose | 0, 30, 60 or 90 days |
| Timely enrollment window | 31 calendar days after first becoming eligible |
| Member addition reporting window | 31 calendar days after the qualifying event |
| Annual open enrollment | runs during the 30 calendar days before the renewal date |

## What each entry means

- **Minimum regular hours**: employees regularly working at least this many hours per week are eligible.
- **Domestic partners (Yes)**: domestic partners may be enrolled as dependents.
- **Retirees (Yes)**: the group may keep retirees enrolled.
- **Late-entrant rules apply (Yes)**: employees enrolling outside open enrollment, the new-hire window and special enrollment enter as late entrants.
- **New-hire waiting periods**: the list of new-hire eligibility waiting periods, in days, from which the employer chooses.
- **Timely enrollment window**: the calendar days after first becoming eligible within which an employee must enroll to avoid late-entrant status.
- **Member addition reporting window**: the calendar days after the qualifying event within which the employer must report an addition for it to take effect on the normal date.
- **Open enrollment**: the calendar days before the renewal date during which the annual open enrollment runs.

## Hours standard on both sides (hypothetical schedules)

| Hypothetical regular weekly hours | 2-19, 20-49 and 50-99 segments (30-hour standard) | 100-249, 250-999 and 1000 Plus segments (20-hour standard) |
|---|---|---|
| 32 | meets the hours standard | meets the hours standard |
| 30 | meets the hours standard | meets the hours standard |
| 25 | does not meet the hours standard | meets the hours standard |
| 20 | does not meet the hours standard | meets the hours standard |
| 18 | does not meet the hours standard | does not meet the hours standard |

## Window illustration (hypothetical dates)

An employee who first becomes eligible on a given day and enrolls 20 calendar days later enrolls within the 31-day timely enrollment window; an employee who enrolls 45 calendar days after first becoming eligible, outside open enrollment and special enrollment, has enrolled outside that window, and in a segment where late-entrant rules apply enters as a late entrant.
